Al Subeaei's current charitable duties extend beyond a ceremonial title. The foundation's trustees oversee grant policy, partnerships and institutional programmes for community organisations across Saudi Arabia. Its work combines direct support with capacity building intended to make nonprofit institutions more effective and sustainable.

His business career has also included board service at AIMS, whose portfolio reaches across property, hospitality, manufacturing and investments.
